item.title: Green officially closes state agencies as Kona low hits islands
item.description: Governor Josh Green, M.D. announced closures for all public and charter schools and state offices on Oʻahu, Kaua‘i and in Maui County on Friday, March 13, due to severe weather expected across the islands.
